classification_notes: A single-user field data entry tool with local storage and CSV export. Runs on the author's own devices.

flags.title: No exclusions stated
flags.body: The input never says what this is NOT. Unstated don't-wants become bugs.

flags.title: Vague term: fast
flags.body: 'Fast sync' is used without a concrete definition.

agents.rationale: Local-first storage shape drives every other decision.
Field data entry on a phone under poor conditions is a UX problem.
Solo-developer scope risk needs explicit sequencing.
